Name: Vulkan Cave - Farm Cave and PIF
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Most tiles in the cave is tillable and has special tilled soil graphics.
[*]The location is marked as a greenhouse and grows crops & fruit trees all year around.
[*]Grass will spread in this location, but not weeds. For aesthetic reasons the cave is set to "Fall" all year around, giving you orange regular grass and purple blue grass.
[*]There's a functional minecart in the little cubby, which is configurable.
[/list]
[size=4]Adding buildings to the Cave:[/size]
[list]
[*]This feature requires another mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Action Properties[/url], making any location buildable is a vanilla feature but I did not want to clutter up the carpenter build menus.
[*]The golden chest on the wall can be interacted with to open the Carpenter build menu, allowing you to place buildings in the cave. This tile can be hidden via configs if unneeded.
[*]A 7x4 space is reserved for a barn or slime hutch sized building. This space looks like it's 7x3 because a small bit of the wall is marked buildable but not passable.
[*]Only Carpenter buildings are allowed, for arbitrary vibe reasons.
[/list]
[size=4]PIF Cave Only:[/size]
[list]
[*]Adds [font=Courier New]Dimension Ladder - Pele[/font], a PIF enabled ladder decor which goes on the floor.
[*]The minecart is off by default in the PIF version.
[/list]

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list]
[*]The CP farm cave replacer and the PIF room are independent, you can install either or both (or neither I suppose :u).
[/list]

[size=4]Translations:[/size]
[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]
